class.name: JRPGEraseEventCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: removes the event running it until the player enters another map.
class.description: The map event running the command is gone until the player enters another map ([method JRPGGameState.erase_event]): it shows nothing, blocks nothing and runs no page. The rest of its commands still run. Without a map event, or once the player is on another map, nothing happens. Authority: server.
